_source: pad positions read from the JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library (https://lceda.cn/ , https://easyeda.com); this file keeps only the rotation and offset measured from them

C207061|FuseHolder_Blade_ATO_Littelfuse_.by: hand: the grids are identical to 0.016 mm; the automatic fit failed only because our eight holes carry TWO numbers (one per terminal) and the fab numbers them 1..8, so fewer than two numbers are shared. The half turn is decided by our 2.4 mm NPTH spigot, which sits at the grid's own centre (x +6.400 of 0.0..12.8) and so maps onto itself; a fuse conducts either way, so the terminals need no handedness

C260296|TO-263-2.by: hand: numbering agrees at 180 deg (1->1, 2->2, 3->3); the residual is LAND DESIGN, not orientation -- the fab draws the tab 1.44 mm further from the leads than we do. 0.48 mm on the leads, 0.96 on the tab, all along X: 10% of a 4.60 mm lead and 10% of a 9.40 mm tab, 0% across

C67279|TO-252-3_TabPin2.by: hand: position fit at 90 deg after dropping our middle-lead pad, which the fab's footprint does not have (it merges that lead into the tab). Residual is 0.31 mm on the leads and 0.62 on the tab, all along X and zero across: 14% of a 2.20 mm lead's LENGTH, 10% of the tab's width. Numbering agrees 1->1, 3->3, tab->2
